overview_description.description:
Radar is a location data infrastructure platform that helps growth and product teams to build location-aware app experiences. It provides a location platform for mobile applications. The platform has four context types, supporting geofencing, place detection, home/work/traveling detection, and country/state/DMA detection for Geofences, Places, Insights, and Regions. 

Radar develops can integrate their applications via mobile SDK, API and server-side integrations, such as Segment, Braze, mParticle, and Amplitude. The Radar has three new APIs available in private beta such as Geocoding, allows developers to turn any address into latitude and longitude coordinates (and vice versa), as well as detect a country or region based on IP address and Search, allows developers to search geofences, places and users near a specific location, and Distance, can calculate the travel distance between two locations.

about_short_description.short_description: Radar is a location data infrastructure platform that helps growth and product teams to build location-aware app experiences.

product.name: Radar Geofencing
product.description: A location-tracking and geofencing platform for detecting entry, exit, visits, trips, and on-premise presence using GPS, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and cellular signals.

product.name: Radar Maps
product.description: A maps platform providing base maps, geocoding, address autocomplete and validation, search, routing, distance calculations, and turn-by-turn directions through APIs and SDKs.

product.name: Radar Protect
product.description: A fraud and compliance solution that uses location and device signals to detect spoofing, VPNs, account abuse, device tampering, and geographic eligibility violations.

product.name: Radar Optimize
product.description: A location operations solution for real-time trip, worker, vehicle, and delivery tracking, with arrival detection, live ETAs, alerts, and workflow automation.

product.name: Radar Engage
product.description: A location-based engagement solution for triggering notifications, in-app messages, and audience segments based on geofences, place visits, proximity, and location history.

product.name: Radar Reveal
product.description: A web and mobile traffic risk detection product that identifies suspicious activity using location, device, and related signals.
